findings.fix: Define the connected case as a full subcategory of the general one: `abbrev ConnectedCoveringSpace (X : TopCat.{u}) := ObjectProperty.FullSubcategory fun p : CoveringSpace X ↦ ConnectedSpace (p : TopCat)`, with `forget := ObjectProperty.ι _` and `fullyFaithfulForget := ObjectProperty.fullyFaithfulι _`, and derive the connected-cover lemmas from the `CoveringSpace` ones through that fully faithful inclusion rather than re-deriving each from `Over`.
findings.issue: `ConnectedCoveringSpace` is a special case of `CoveringSpace` (its defining property is `IsCoveringMap p.hom ∧ ConnectedSpace p.left`), yet lines 165–259 re-prove the whole `CoveringSpace` API verbatim from `Over X`: `totalSpace`, the `CoeOut`, `mk`, `mk_coe`, `proj`, `mk_proj`, `totalSpace_obj`, `w`, `homMk`, `homMk_hom_left`, `isoMk`, `isoMk_hom_hom_left`, `isoMk_inv_hom_left`, `mkProjIso`, the `IsIso f.hom.left` instance, and `isIso_iff_isHomeomorph` — 15 declarations with statements and proofs identical to lines 66–148 modulo the type.

findings.fix: Prove the general lemma once — `{p q : Over X} (f : p ⟶ q) : IsIso f ↔ IsHomeomorph f.left`, from `isIso_iff_of_reflects_iso _ (Over.forget X)` (`Over.forget_reflects_iso`, Mathlib/CategoryTheory/Comma/Over/Basic.lean:302) and `TopCat.isIso_iff_isHomeomorph` — then obtain both subcategory versions via `ObjectProperty.isIso_hom_iff`; likewise define `isoMk` as `ObjectProperty.isoMk (Over.isoMk e w)` instead of constructing `hom`/`inv` and re-proving `e.inv_comp_eq` in each namespace.
findings.issue: `isIso_iff_isHomeomorph` (lines 145 and 256) and `isoMk` (lines 120 and 228) use nothing about `IsCoveringMap` or `ConnectedSpace`; the content is a fact about `Over X` for `X : TopCat` plus Mathlib's generic full-subcategory transfer, but it is stated only at the covering-specific level and hand-built twice.

summary: The `ConnectedCoveringSpace` namespace re-proves the entire `CoveringSpace` API from scratch for a strictly smaller subcategory instead of deriving it, and the shared content of those lemmas (`isoMk`, the iso-vs-homeomorphism criterion, `w`, the `IsIso` instance) is not about covering maps at all — it lives at the `Over X` level for `X : TopCat`.
